Chapter 1035: 3: Global Conflict (Vote For Monthly Pass)_2

Chapter 1035: Chapter 3: Global Conflict (Vote for Monthly Pass)_2

This Martial Tao of Force was specifically tailored and perfected by Lin Yuan for the Ancient Power Supreme Being.

With Lin Yuan’s realm, he had already seen through the strengths and weaknesses of the Ancient Power Supreme Being.

Using the Martial Tao as the foundation, perfecting a Martial Tao of Force suitable for the Ancient Power Supreme Being is all too simple.

After all, it wasn’t created out of thin air.

“Ancient Power, I suggest you transition to practicing this Martial Tao of Force,” said the Xia Qin Supreme Being, standing beside him.

“I feel the same way.” The Ancient Power Supreme Being’s expression was enthusiastic. He then tentatively asked Lin Yuan, “Galaxy, may I transition to cultivating this Martial Tao of Force?”

This Martial Tao of Force was proposed by Lin Yuan, and it branched from the path Lin Yuan himself followed. Naturally, before transitioning to practice it, he needed Lin Yuan’s approval.

“No problem.”

Lin Yuan said with a smile.

The Ancient Power Supreme Being transitioning to cultivating the Martial Tao of Force also benefits Lin Yuan greatly.

Under normal circumstances, even if the Martial Tao of Force were made publicly available to all citizens of human civilization, no one knows how long it would take to give rise to a practitioner of the Twelve-layer Martial Tao of Force.

Having an evolutionary path doesn’t necessarily result in the emergence of a Twelfth Layer.

But the Ancient Power Supreme Being? He himself is already at the Twelfth Layer. If he chooses to “abandon his path” and cultivates the Martial Tao of Force again, re-entering the Twelfth Layer will likely pose no bottleneck risks.

“If Ancient Power transitions to cultivating the Martial Tao of Force, he might become humanity’s second Path Splitting Realm pinnacle level Supreme Being,” the Void God Supreme Being sighed, “human civilization’s future will grow even stronger.”

“Don’t rush,” Lin Yuan said from the side, “I’ve also prepared some additional branches for you all.”

The Xuanyuan Supreme Being, Xia Qin Supreme Being, Feather Butterfly Supreme Being, and the other eight supreme beings were momentarily stunned.

Lin Yuan continued to transmit the eight Martial Tao branches such as the “Dark Martial Path” and “Dream Martial Path” to them.

“This?”

The eight supreme beings took a deep breath and quickly began reading and analyzing.

After a long while.

The Xia Qin Supreme Being suddenly opened his eyes, his gaze dark and eerie, then quickly returned to normal.

“Galaxy, this evolutionary path…” The Xia Qin Supreme Being’s voice trembled slightly, looking toward Lin Yuan.

“Dream Martial Path, Phantasm Reality—this evolutionary path could transcend into the Domination Realm without much issue,” the Feather Butterfly Supreme Being’s eyes sparkled with unprecedented brilliance. “Cultivating it to the extreme, I will transform into a Phantasmal lifeform. Even Chaos Venerables will need considerable effort to deal with me.”

“Indeed.”

The other supreme beings nodded in agreement; they too were awed by the Martial Tao branches Lin Yuan had transmitted.

“Galaxy, these…” The Xuanyuan Supreme Being looked at Lin Yuan, his expression filled with excitement.

“You can all cultivate them,” Lin Yuan said directly.

Perfecting and extending specialized Martial Tao branches for the nine supreme beings of humanity was entirely a mutually beneficial endeavor.

The Martial Tao foundation Lin Yuan followed would grow even deeper, and the nine supreme beings of humanity could also reach even higher and further into the future.

“There are still dozens of Martial Tao branches, each of which could serve as an entirely new evolutionary path into the Twelfth Layer.” Lin Yuan revealed all the extended and perfected Martial Tao branches he had developed.

A total of seventy-three paths.

The nine supreme beings exchanged glances, with the shock in their hearts diminishing slightly.

At least with the prior examples of Thunder Martial Path and other perfectly tailored branches for the nine supreme beings as a foundation, the addition of dozens of Twelfth Layer branches wasn’t something overly unfathomable.

Next.

Lin Yuan chatted a bit more with the nine supreme beings, as the Xia Qin Supreme Being and Xuanyuan Supreme Being began discussions on who would be the first to “abandon one’s path” and transition to cultivating a Martial Tao branch.

No matter how powerful a Twelfth Layer being is—whether in the Path Splitting Realm, Domination Realm, or Chaos Realm—once they abandon their path, their power will plummet drastically. Hence, humanity’s nine supreme beings would never simultaneously “abandon their paths.”

Although humanity possesses Lin Yuan as their “Pillar of the Sea Calm,” they cannot rely solely on Lin Yuan to handle everything.

The result of their discussion determined that, at most, only two supreme beings would be permitted to “abandon their paths” in the same period.

Before these two supreme beings re-enter the Twelfth Layer, the remaining seven supreme beings would need to shoulder the responsibility of maintaining the order of human civilization.

…

Unlike other Twelfth Layer beings, humanity’s nine supreme beings grew up together from their weaker years, forming an exceptional trust among them, which gave them the courage to be the first to “abandon their paths.”

After all, once they abandon their paths and lose their foundational route, a Twelfth Layer being would possess only their essence but no strength. To other beings at the same level, they would become an extraordinary and unique “supreme elixir.”

No matter if it were consumed or melted down, it would greatly enhance the consumer.

…

After making the Martial Tao branches publicly available to humanity, Lin Yuan resumed his secluded cultivation.

“Refining these resources, my ‘Xuanhuang Physique’ should be able to achieve perfection in the Domination Realm,” Lin Yuan said, taking out a purple cloth pouch.

Inside were the resources obtained by selling eighteen Domination Realm wonder trees.

These materials, coupled with the ones Lin Yuan had accumulated during other times, as well as his spoils from defeating the Serpent Demon Dominator and Blood Guardian Dominator, constituted nearly all his possessions.

Serpent Demon Dominator and Blood Guardian Dominator were infamous plunderers, with wealth far exceeding that of ordinary Domination Realm pinnacle beings.

…

Source World.

Qingfen Domain, Sky Burning Court.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged in the thirteenth-level chamber, continuing his cultivation methodically.

“Becoming the disciple of Lord Qingfen offers far better treatment than staying in the Yu Family,” Lin Yuan thought to himself. It wasn’t that he thought the Yu Family was inadequate, but under Lord Qingfen’s tutelage, he could significantly reduce the time spent on trivial matters.

He could devote all his focus and energy to cultivation.
